hints.tr: İlk satır `>` ile, sonrakiler `>>` ile. Yanlış yazarsan ilk satırı `>` ile baştan yazmak dosyayı sıfırlar.
hints.en: The first line with `>`, the next ones with `>>`. If you make a mistake, writing the first line again with `>` resets the file.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı (komutları sırayla yaz):

```bash
echo "eggs" > shopping.txt
echo "bread" >> shopping.txt
echo "tea" >> shopping.txt
cat shopping.txt
```
hints.en:
The full solution (type the commands in order):

```bash
echo "eggs" > shopping.txt
echo "bread" >> shopping.txt
echo "tea" >> shopping.txt
cat shopping.txt
```

label.en: You printed the file with cat
